flows.title: Send files by email
steps: Enter your own email address and the address you are sending to.
Give the transfer a title and a message if you want one.
Click Transfer and wait for the upload to finish.
WeTransfer emails a download link to each person separately, so no one sees anyone else's address, and emails you again once the files have been downloaded.

flows.title: Share files with a link instead of email
steps: Click the ellipsis icon in the bottom-left corner of the transfer window and choose the link option.
Click Transfer and wait for the upload to finish.
Copy the link and share it however you like. WeTransfer sends no email for you here, so passing the link on is yours to do.
